newsitem.title: BRAZIL: J.P. Morgan's LatAm M&A deals hit $1.2 bln in Q1.
newsitem.headline: J.P. Morgan's LatAm M&A deals hit $1.2 bln in Q1.

text.p: J.P. Morgan & Co Inc said it closed eight merger and acquisition deals with a total worth of $1.284 billion in Latin America in the first quarter of the year.

In Brazil, the three most important deals coordinated by the bank included a joint-venture between Aetna Inc International and Sul America Seguros insurance firm, the sale of a 66.66 percent stake in Microlite SA to Varta AG and the acquisition of part of Net Sul cable TV by Rede Brasil Sul (RBS) television network, J.P. Morgan said in a statement.
The bank also said it ranked the first among 15 banks in mergers and acquisitions in Latin America in the first quarter, according to Securities Data Company.
